newsitem.title: BRAZIL: France Telecom to bid for Brazil telcom shrs - paper.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom to bid for Brazil telcom shrs - paper.

text.p: France Telecom will join a consortium to bid for a 35 percent stake in Rio Grande do Sul state's telecom firm Companhia Riograndense de Telecomunicacoes (CRT), a local newspaper said.
The consortium will also include Brazilian investors, including pension funds, Roland Geldwerth, vice-president of France Telecom America del Sur, told Gazeta Mercantil newspaper.
Rio Grande do Sul state government is offering up to 35 percent of the company's voting capital under a sale process the state expects to conclude in December.
Gazeta also said banks Opportunity and Banco do Brasil de Investimentos may join the consortium.

CRT is a telecommunications company which is not part of the federally owned Telebras system. Telebras has 14 percent of CRT's total capital, while the remainder is in the hands of Rio Grande do Sul state government.
